cases.summary: Status of a root with no server is stopped. A served boot reports running; a stalled viewer shows 4096 queued bytes, a nonzero lag and the resynchronized byte range 4096..8191; a recorded corruption stays degraded across repeated metrics reads and in the CLI status; latency rows count settled calls; every answer arrives within 2 s and names the hello boot. A dead socket at the default endpoint is stale_endpoint, and after stop the endpoint is stopped twice in a row without a new socket.
